minutes.headline: Planning Board continued Highfield Village to Aug 22 and approved a nine-lot Northfield Road stormwater permit.
minutes.summary: The board reorganized, choosing officers and committee representatives by roll call. It granted Highfield Village a continuance while the applicant seeks a zoning board special permit, continued the 234 Summer Street site plan hearing to June 13 with fence directions, and approved a nine-lot Northfield Road stormwater special permit with conditions. Committee reports and a discussion of rules and regulations and land clearing followed.

what_happened.line: The Planning Board approved a special permit for stormwater control on a nine-lot Northfield Road development, with conditions.
The board continued the Highfield Village matter to Aug 22 and put review of the applicant's zoning board filing on the next agenda.
The 234 Summer Street site plan hearing was continued to June 13; the board gave fence directions that were not voted as conditions.
A public hearing on site plan and special permit rules was set for June 27, with member comments due to the director before June 13.
The board reorganized, choosing officers and committee representatives by roll call.

why_it_matters: The Northfield Road permit sets drainage conditions for nine new lots, and a residential neighbor at 234 Summer Street was heard on fence, noise and contamination concerns, so both touch nearby properties and runoff.
The June 27 hearing on site plan and special permit rules is a chance for residents to comment on how future development applications are reviewed.
watch_next: June 13: the 234 Summer Street site plan hearing resumes, and member comments on the rules are due to the director.
June 27: public hearing on site plan and special permit rules; Aug 22 at 6:30: Highfield Village returns.
